objective: GEO workspace beside AI builder, serving existing managed sites
requirements: Site-isolated persistent facts, questions, observations, audits and content proposals with optimistic concurrency
Chinese and English interface and separately generated content sharing approved fact identities
Fact evidence URLs, verification dates, expiry and explicit approval
Versioned questions by intent, market and language
Read-only public website diagnostics with SSRF protection and explicit limits
Import real observations with raw answers, citations, platform, mode, environment and timestamp; failures are not absence
Separate manual consumer observations, grounded API probes, official reports and simulations
Metrics grouped by comparable sampling conditions with raw evidence export; no invented visibility or causal growth claims
Configured real LLM creates question suggestions and evidence-grounded page proposals; no implicit search claim
Review proposals before transferring to the existing page draft and publication workflow
Responsive step interface with accessible forms, empty/error/busy states and unsaved-change protection
Backend authorization, validation, concurrency and isolation tests plus browser end-to-end coverage
Verify release packaging includes the GEO module and deployed runtime works
scope_notes: Initial visibility acquisition supports evidence import; official report APIs and search connectors must be verified before automatic acquisition is enabled
Technical diagnostics do not claim to prove index inclusion or verified bot access
Demonstration sites may test functionality but are not evidence of real business growth

implementation.prompt_management: Existing prompt library, GEO category; six modules per language, additive seed migration preserves custom text and history.
implementation.observation_acquisition: Manual evidence import and official OpenAI/Gemini grounded API collection; verified connections, durable plans and quota-bound jobs.
implementation.diagnostics: Pinned public IP HTTP fetch, HTML, robots, sitemap and response indexing headers; WAF/verified bots and index inclusion require external verification
implementation.publishing: Reviewed proposal appends a sanitized section to existing page draft; existing preview, publication journal and restore remain authoritative

verification_commands: KF_E2E_REAL_AI_BASE=<configured-base> KF_E2E_REAL_AI_PROFILE=<real-profile> npm run test:geo:live --prefix tests/ui

research_update.access: Full text retrieved through r.jina.ai after direct origin timed out. White paper is research input, not an API specification.
implemented_in_working_tree: Separate metric groups by question identity and immutable version as well as platform, model, channel, environment, language, market, brand and batch.
Display sample denominators, failed/unsupported/no-search counts and successful answers without citations.
Add per-question 95% Wilson reference intervals with explicit independent-sample assumption; repeated samples may be correlated. Do not infer causal uplift.
Export sample dates and cited-domain answer counts; do not count retrieved-but-uncited sources as answer citations.

next_delivery.requirement: Finish existing official OpenAI/Gemini adapters, encrypted connection management, quotas, scheduling and real-interface validation. API observations remain distinct from consumer product observations. No-search answers remain available as evidence, with denominator policy visible.

Allow operator-controlled repeat counts and multiple date windows with total request estimate and quota checks. Never automatically increase paid sampling to match a white-paper recommendation. Add stable question-set and collection-protocol versions before cross-batch comparison.

Version brand aliases, owned domains and explicitly selected competitors; separately review mention, recommendation and factual accuracy. Brand-name detection alone is not a recommendation. Define share-of-voice denominator before reporting it.

Reuse bilingual modular prompt library for neutral question variants, funnel coverage, direct factual answers, conditions, prices/dates when evidenced, citations and source freshness. Preserve operator customizations and prompt history; never generate unsupported awards, reviews or ranking promises.

Classify frequently cited sources as owned, independent, community, marketplace or unknown with operator review. Reuse existing task workflow for evidence-backed outreach/content tasks; no automatic third-party posting.

Separate search, training and user-triggered crawler policies; verify each provider against current official documentation. robots.txt and a successful HTTP response do not prove verified crawler access or index inclusion. No mandatory llms.txt or invented GEO schema.

Link publication history to baseline/retest windows and control questions. Require comparable question/protocol versions. Add cluster-aware intervals for aggregates; do not interpret non-overlapping intervals alone as causal evidence. Keep referral analytics, self-reported acquisition and visibility distinct; missing attribution remains unknown.

research_update.interface: Preserve six-step GEO workflow, shared AdminUI tables/forms, SiteContext, bilingual text and progressive disclosure. Connection credentials belong in system settings; per-site plans belong in audit/observations; evidence and uncertainty belong in reports.
not_adopted_as_facts: White-paper traffic, platform-adoption and uplift percentages without validating their original studies.
A universal minimum sample count or confidence guarantee.
Gemini API results as Google AI Overviews/AI Mode visibility.
Automatic crawler-policy changes or claims that a special schema guarantees citations.
research_update.release_status: Source implementation verified. Release acceptance additionally requires the exact packaged browser suite, successful CI and matching runtime manifests on both installations.

implementation_status.sampling: Implemented manual/6h/12h/daily/weekly schedules, repeats 1–40, request estimates/caps, immutable question and protocol snapshots; comparison rejects differing conditions and mixed question versions.
implementation_status.brand_entities: Implemented aliases, owned domains and up to ten competitors, versioned snapshots, literal-match evidence, separate human mention/recommendation/accuracy reviews and explicit selected-brand share-of-voice denominator.
implementation_status.content_and_prompts: Added six bilingual modules without overwriting customized modules; content context includes observed source evidence and operator source reviews, while factual claims still require approved facts.
implementation_status.source_opportunities: Evidence-linked source-domain classification and reviewed opportunity notes; handoff reuses existing GEO proposal, page draft and publication workflow. No third-party posting.
implementation_status.technical_access: Read-only purpose-specific robots rules for search, training, Google-Extended and user-triggered fetchers, with current official source links and explicit unverified actual access.
implementation_status.experiments_and_attribution: Immutable publication-linked baseline/retest snapshots with observed time windows, optional controls, descriptive differences and paired whole-question bootstrap intervals. Separate manually evidenced referral/self-reported/unknown attribution; missing counts remain null and overlapping periods are not pooled.

automatic_collection.connections: Admin-only GEO search connections reuse the encrypted ProviderStore; official OpenAI profile import never returns credentials to the browser. Connections require a version-matched search probe.
automatic_collection.plans: Site-scoped question and account snapshots, 1–40 repetitions, manual/6h/12h/daily/weekly schedules, at most 120 requests per round, UTC daily quota reserved before network I/O.
automatic_collection.runs: Existing ActionStore journal; exclusive admission per plan, idempotent requests, explicit retries, pause between requests, no automatic replay after restart.
automatic_collection.evidence: Original answer, answer citations, distinct retrieved sources, actual search calls, model, usage and raw response. Google suggestions are displayed in an opaque script-free iframe. No-search and incomplete results remain inspectable.

verification.unit_and_http: 9 collection tests passed, including credential redaction, permissions, archive scope, quota corruption, duplicate submission and restart behavior.
verification.baseline_python: 198 Python tests passed, including collection, analysis, experiment, attribution and HTTP authorization coverage.
verification.live_openai: Official configured gpt-6-astra web search succeeded; full disposable browser connection-import/probe/plan/run/evidence workflow passed.
verification.gemini: Adapter follows retrieved official Interactions search schema; no configured Gemini credential, live verification pending.
verification.browser: Full project browser regression passed. Expanded GEO flow covers entities, source review, comparison, publication-linked experiments, unknown attribution, bilingual UI, mobile layout and delayed collection progress.
verification.live_content: Configured real LLM passed separate English/Chinese question and proposal generation with evidence snapshots and reviewed draft transfer.

automatic_collection.deployment: Acceptance is verified against the exact release archive, CI results and installed release.json manifests; runtime data and credentials are excluded from releases.
